comment: The theme sliders are combined with an exclusive-nor rather than an exclusive-or, so a theme with every slider on OFF is a stable pattern instead of silence. The four interval taps form a four-bit number whose low three bits index the scale and whose top bit adds an octave, which is why the melody's range is a little over an octave before the root is applied.
